trickyParts: The order of the close's rows against store/issue_suspend.go's fences: a root's check start row is written after the linger's suspends and IssueSuspend rows so the root's own suspension finishes without acting (restarted) and the start resumes the implementer in the still-live pod; a pending report's suspend and IssueSuspend both follow the look's start row so they act; a child's close writes no IssueSuspend at all and the check's close writes the releasing one
A check start row carries CheckLook and is fenced on the open check and its look in the outbox's supervise(), not on the generation or the lingering tree; an operator hold met by one ends the look

lingerExpired returns wait.Until while a tree's check is open, which rolls the fact back without consuming the linger event id; the outbox's retry honours the moment; closeCheck re-arms LingerClose when the last check of a lingering tree closes

The handoff route tells a check report (implementer on a done issue with an open check) from a phase completion before requiring a commit; api cannot import workflow (a test import cycle), so the predicate is issue.Phase == done
The daemon API collided with main's 30 (sjawhar/legion#1986) during the forward merge: this branch is 31

The Stage 4b mid-turn hold must start before READY, since the merge is now the close and can land seconds after READY; both rigs use production_check_hours 0.25 because a look open at the bound is deferred by the 2 h look bound

round 2: a check instance's identity is its OpenedAt, truncated to microseconds at open so the engine's value equals Postgres's; pgx decodes timestamptz in Local, so every comparison is Equal/UnixMicro; a zero OpenedAt on a row or fact names no instance (the tester's rows carry none) and is not fenced
deviations: Plan departures 1-3 built as the plan records them (the child's Sandbox goes Suspended at the first look's pending, not at the close; production_check_hours (336 by default); builtFromRepository constant guarded by the revision)

Architect's addition: at a release boot the daemon reads Dispatch's build commit from GET /healthz (dispatch.Client.BuildCommit) and compares it against open checks in sjawhar/legion as `dispatch build <sha>`, idempotent with the server.started wake; skipped when it equals the daemon's own revision (one compare)
daemon.Run takes a daemon.Build{Revision, Repository} parameter (no daemon.Options existed); workflow.Config gained BuiltFrom; DaemonBooted gained Revision and DispatchBuild
DaemonAPIVersion is 31, not the plan's 30: main released pi-legion v10.8.3 declaring 30 for sjawhar/legion#1986 before this branch merged

The rigs set production_check_hours 0.25 (not 0.1) and Stage 4b linger_hours 0.5 (was 0.3); Stage 4b's child-4 hold starts before the merger's READY; the bound's last look is its own checkpoint `production-check-bound` in both scripts
api/handoff.go decides a check report by issue.Phase == done rather than workflow.RoleFor == "" (an import cycle in tests); the two agree for every done issue

The live proofs were rewritten and syntax-checked but not run from the pod; per the architect, Stage 4b at the head is the proof surface and is run by the devbox holder, Stage 3 is no proof, the tester holds for the Stage 4b evidence; a later push that changes runtime code needs the stage again
